channel.title: Folkweb news
channel.description: News about Folkweb, the browser extension for a web made by people.

item.title: Folkweb is available for Firefox
item.description: Folkweb 0.2.0 is approved on Firefox Add-ons for desktop Firefox. The Chrome Web Store submission is still under review; Firefox for Android is not supported yet.

item.title: You can now support Folkweb
item.description: Folkweb stays free and complete for everyone. You can now donate through Ko-fi or Liberapay, with GitHub Sponsors to follow. Donations are gifts: no perks, and no say over the lists. Every year we'll publish what came in and what it paid for. The privacy policy now explains what we see when you donate.

item.title: Folkweb is being built
item.description: Folkweb is a free browser extension that shows signs of the people behind what you read, lets you choose whose judgement to trust, and quiets the noise. It is in testing now; this feed will announce the launch for Firefox, Edge and Chrome.
